scientific_role: development-only design, model-semantics, and evidence audit; not a personalization experiment

protected_fields.actuator_lengthrange: DO_NOT_PERTURB unless exact physiological and geometry-consistent mapping is independently established; no smoke perturbation
protected_fields.single_site_geometry_move: DO_NOT_PERTURB without coupled path rebuild and calibration

mechanistic_value_rule: A factor must have actual model semantics and a plausible configuration-dependent effect; larger perturbation producing larger torque alone is insufficient

mechanistic_nonproportionality_metrics.proportional_fit: perturbed response versus nominal response through origin over the frozen trajectory subset
mechanistic_nonproportionality_metrics.affine_fit: perturbed response versus nominal response with intercept
mechanistic_nonproportionality_metrics.residual_trajectory_dependence: NRMSE after proportional and affine fits
mechanistic_nonproportionality_metrics.local_sensitivity_shape: coefficient of variation of central finite-difference log sensitivity across trajectories
mechanistic_nonproportionality_metrics.gradient_direction: sign and cosine of beta-flex/beta-extend local finite differences
mechanistic_nonproportionality_metrics.component_interaction: two-way perturbation-level by trajectory residual where an existing frozen component semantic is available

mechanistic_nonproportionality_threshold.interpretation: thresholds classify local numerical non-proportionality only, never a population effect size or subject range

tiny_smoke_test_policy.trajectory_selection: reference, four corners, and four axis extrema from beta geometry only
tiny_smoke_test_policy.magnitude_rule: dimensionless fields use plus/minus 1e-4 in their native normalized coordinate; positive scale fields use plus/minus 1e-4 in log scale; positive dimensional fields use plus/minus 1e-4 relative change; no value is a subject bound
probe_priority_order: normalized muscle operating-range position/shape field if exact built-in-muscle semantics and safe coherent mutation are confirmed
anatomically declared antagonist or biarticular relative fpmax balance using existing muscle-specific fpmax fields
actual non-limit joint damping or stiffness field if nonzero and semantically separable from simulator limit handling
actual tendon elastic field only if present, calibrated, and independently mutable
tiny_smoke_test_policy.ineligible_probe_action: record NOT_RUN_WITH_REASON; do not substitute a post-result factor

design_readiness_rules.MYOLEG_HETEROGENEITY_EXPANSION_DESIGN_RE: at least one 4-8D primary scheme uses only exact, geometry-consistent fields; every primary factor has E1/E2 range evidence or a predeclared calibration route; and eligible local probes show integrity plus mechanistic non-proportionality

at least one 4-8D primary scheme is field-implementable and geometry-consistent with plausible or locally demonstrated non-proportionality, but one or more population ranges or mappings remain RANGE_REQUIRES_EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE
design_readiness_rules.MYOLEG_HETEROGENEITY_EXPANSION_DESIGN_NO: no parsimonious scheme has exact field semantics and geometry consistency, or every eligible candidate is magnitude-only/stress-only/unsafe
